label: Raritan Dominion KX III KX3-864 KVM-over-IP switch
description: 2RU KVM-over-IP switch for up to 64 servers over UTP cabling with 8 simultaneous remote users, dual 10/100/1000 Ethernet access and a DB9 RS-232 modem/serial port.
notes: 64 KVM ports over Cat5/5e/6 with D2CIM dongles (not Ethernet, not modelled); 2 x 10/100/1000 gigabit Ethernet, dual-stack IPv4/IPv6, dual AC power, DVI-D local port, tiering port, 1 x DB9(F) DTE modem/serial port. Serial capacity can be raised to 8 devices with DSAM-4/DSAM-8 Dominion Serial Access Modules - those add RS-232 devices, not network ports, so add serial ports there if a lab uses them.
